review_method: Direct RGB review confirms four lawn-interior columns. Distributed first ground returns support three columns; the remaining column has the previously accepted raster-pair support. Rooted dirt is retained below ground and recognized as solid support. Original negative raster values are not overwritten. Final obstruction/terrain conflict checks preserve exactly the same four qualified proposals; low vegetation classification alone is contextual, not a fabricated overhead structure.

lidar_provenance.lineage: Raw returns, DTM and DSM share one survey lineage; these are alternative analyses, not independent sources

scope: Only the four accepted columns. Retain all earlier repairs, material boundaries, vegetation, uncertain floating surfaces and underground geometry. No model promotion.
